videos.specTitle: What we confirm against your enquiry
videos.specIntro: The specification points that decide price, lead time and fit — settled in the quotation before the run.
videos.faqTitle: Questions buyers ask about this video
videos.faqIntro: The two questions this footage raises most often from distributors and fabrication shops.
videos.whyTitle: Why buyers use MoTai as their abrasive source
videos.why1b: Cloth, cutting, slitting, hot pressing, checking and packing happen on the same site, so the spec you confirm is the spec that ships.
videos.why2b: Standard widths and grits are racked and ready, which keeps replenishment orders short for distributors.
videos.why3b: Your logo, labels, sizes and packaging, quoted against your confirmed specification with a feasibility review.
videos.moreIntro: Other footage covering the same product family.
videos.noneBody: Send the application, material and volume — we reply with the specification, lead time and price.
videos.linesIntro: Choose the family you convert or resell, or start at the top and work down.
videos.trustSub: Three product lines supplied to seven destination regions, from one site.
videos.trustNote: Figures describe the plant shown in the footage; order-level terms are confirmed in the quotation.
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.s1: Converting in-house: master-roll cutting, slitting, joint making and hot pressing on one site
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.s2: Grit coverage 40–5000 across aluminium oxide, zirconia and silicon carbide grain
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.s4: Ultra-wide belts above 1500 mm supplied single-piece, no joint to fail
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.q1: Can I visit this factory place before ordering?
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.a1: Yes. Factory visits are arranged with our team and the meeting point is confirmed before you travel.
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.q2: Are the belts in the video standard sizes or custom?
videos.clip.FdqImhKL29c.a2: Both. The warehouse holds standard widths and grits for immediate shipment; custom widths and lengths run to the confirmed specification.

videos.clip.CJGV6qn3Rf0.s2: Supplied to seven destination regions, factory-direct
videos.clip.CJGV6qn3Rf0.s3: OEM and private-label programmes on all three lines
videos.clip.CJGV6qn3Rf0.s4: Quality checkpoints agreed in the quotation before the run starts
videos.clip.CJGV6qn3Rf0.q1: What is the minimum order for OEM?
videos.clip.CJGV6qn3Rf0.a1: Minimum quantities are quoted per programme and confirmed in the feasibility review with your enquiry.
videos.clip.CJGV6qn3Rf0.a2: Seven destination regions across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia; packing and marks are set per destination.
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.s1: Brand and factory orientation in one short clip
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.s2: Coated abrasives made in Xianning, Hubei
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.s3: Durability standard held on every order: grain, backing and dimensions confirmed first
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.q1: Can I use this video for my own buyer presentation?
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.a1: Yes. Send us the channel link and mention MoTai as the manufacturer; confirm any brand-labelled use with our team first.
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.q2: Who is the manufacturer behind MoTai?
videos.clip.bf5WPCu6HZs.a2: Hubei MoTai Abrasives Materials Co., Ltd., a coated abrasives manufacturer in Xianning, Hubei, China.
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.s1: Standard sizes held in stock for fast replenishment
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.s2: Thousands of abrasive cloth rolls and wide belts racked and ready
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.s3: Stock references ship faster than converted custom orders
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.s4: Custom sizes still run to the confirmed specification
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.q1: How quickly do stock sizes ship?
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.a1: Stock references ship fastest because no converting lead time applies; the confirmed quotation states the dispatch window.
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.q2: Do you hold every grip size in stock?
videos.clip.ZrYsB2XuR3o.a2: Standard widths and grits are stocked; uncommon combinations are converted against a confirmed order.
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.s1: Full tour: exterior, converting line, warehouse, finished product close-up
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.s2: Cloth backing and grain inspected at the end of the line
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.s3: Large-format rolls and heavy-duty belts in the warehouse
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.s4: Same order as our manufacturing steps: cut, check, pack
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.q1: What exactly is checked before an order leaves?
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.a1: Surface against grade, backing type and weight, dimensional tolerance, pack quantities, labels and carton marks.
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.q2: Is the converting line in-house or outsourced?
videos.clip.sdJ-zq2HfjU.a2: In-house. Cutting, slitting, hot pressing, checking and packing happen on the same site.
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.s1: Based in Tongcheng County, Hubei — China's abrasive cloth town
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.s2: Central China production base for ultra-wide abrasive belts
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.s3: Founded 2021; master-roll cutting through to dispatch on one site
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.s4: Single-piece belts above 1500 mm without a joint to fail
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.q1: Why does the location matter for my lead time?
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.a1: Cloth, converting and packing sit in one industrial cluster, so a custom width does not wait on an out-of-town step.
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.q2: Can you supply a single-piece 2000 mm belt?
videos.clip.xBcmPjN7um4.a2: Ultra-wide single-piece belts are quoted case by case; state the width, grit and load so we confirm feasibility.
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.s1: One-stop process: cut the master roll, slit to width, hot press and cure, check and pack
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.s2: Made in Tongcheng, the town that produces the abrasive cloth itself
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.s3: Custom slit widths quoted against your specification
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.s4: Same plant for cloth and converting — shorter lead times on custom sizes
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.q1: What is the difference between buying from here and from a local converter?
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.a1: Cloth and converting are on one site, so a custom width is set before the roll is slit rather than after an intermediary step.
videos.clip.rNbh9PMX-Pw.a2: The hot press and cure of the joint. It is the stage most buyers never see and the one that decides failure.
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.s1: Aluminium oxide cloth flaps over a backing plate
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.s2: Plastic, steel and fiberglass backing options
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.s3: Rated for angle grinders; match disc speed to tool speed
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.s4: Bulk supply for workshops, distributors and fabrication shops
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.q1: How do I choose the flap disc grit?
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.a1: Coarse grit removes stock and cleans welds; fine grit blends and finishes. State the material and the finish required and we confirm the grade.
videos.clip.r0AXUY5EEC8.a2: Fiberglass handles demanding grinding, plastic suits general work and steel suits heavy deburring; the arbor hole must match your tool.
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.s1: Wide abrasive cloth slit to your width in-house
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.s2: Precision slitting equipment with consistent edge condition
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.s3: Serrated or wave-cut edges supplied clean and uniform
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.s4: Custom widths follow from this converting step
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.q1: Can you slit a non-standard width?
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.a1: Yes, within the slitting equipment's range; width tolerance and minimum run length are confirmed in the quotation.
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.q2: What edge condition should I expect?
videos.clip.oAEfepQPN3U.a2: A clean, uniform serrated or wave-cut edge. State the machine and load if a specific edge treatment is required.
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.s1: Flexible, double-sided, multi-grit sanding sponge blocks
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.s2: No grain shedding and no cracking when bent
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.s3: Die-cut to your profile, shape and packaging
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.q1: Can you die-cut a custom shape?
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.a1: Yes. Send your profile, thickness, grit and packaging requirement and we confirm tooling and minimum quantity.
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.q2: Are these blocks washable and reusable?
videos.clip.Iir75GWmjy4.a2: They can be rinsed and reused until the abrasive layer is spent; lifetime depends on grit, pressure and the surface worked.
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.s1: Two-minute wall scratch repair with a hand sanding sponge
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.s2: Fine grit only, light pressure — blending a mark, not stripping paint
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.s3: No dust extraction needed for small areas
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.s4: Also used for putty, primer and decorative surface prep
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.q1: Which grit should I use on painted walls?
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.a1: Fine grade only. A hard disc or coarse grit cuts through the paint surrounding the scratch and enlarges the repair.
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.q2: Do you supply these for retail packaging?
videos.clip.NeE6wfbE-p0.a2: Yes. Sponge blocks are supplied in retail-ready packing, including private-label and custom die-cut formats.
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.s1: Hook-and-loop, PSA and mesh disc formats for four job types
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.s2: Perforated pattern keeps the surface clean while sanding
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.s3: Wood, metal, wall and fine finishing in one product family
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.q1: Hook-and-loop or PSA for my tool?
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.a1: Hook-and-loop suits frequent grit changes on a random-orbit sander; PSA suits flat pads and long run times. Mesh discs suit dust extraction.
videos.clip.EaXFhDu-8Ic.a2: Not required, but a dustless or mesh disc keeps the surface visible so you stop when the scratch is gone instead of sanding on.
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.s1: Abrasive cloth rolls and slit rolls from the source plant
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.s2: In-house production with strict quality control
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.s3: Custom specifications and OEM packing under your label
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.s4: Line to finished warehouse in one short tour
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.q1: Can you slit jumbo rolls to my width?
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.a1: Yes. State the width, length, grade and backing and we confirm tolerance and minimum run length.
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.q2: What do I need to send for an OEM enquiry?
videos.clip.UL8ERdNJJpo.a2: Product and specification, size and grit mix, artwork and labels, packaging format, target quantities, destination and timing.
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.s1: Real field footage: weld bead blending on a steel enclosure
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.s2: Angle grinder with a flap or grinding disc, guard in place
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.s3: Disc presented flat to the work, not loaded on its edge
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.s4: Reference for disc speed and presentation
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.q1: Which disc removes weld beads efficiently?
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.a1: A flap disc rated for the tool's speed removes the bead and blends in one pass; a ceramic or zirconia grit suits heavy weld removal.
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.q2: Is side loading a flap disc safe?
videos.clip.eGdOrKtmgAQ.a2: No. Present the disc flat to the work and keep the guard fitted; edge loading shortens disc life and is unsafe.
videos.clip.IjZBfRGDyys.s1: End of line to sealed export carton in thirty seconds
videos.clip.IjZBfRGDyys.s2: Cartons wrapped and palletised on site
videos.clip.IjZBfRGDyys.s3: Carton marks, pack list and pallet pattern agreed in the quotation
videos.clip.IjZBfRGDyys.s4: Racking and stock control visible in the same tour
videos.clip.IjZBfRGDyys.a1: Marks, pack list and pallet pattern are agreed with the quotation, so nothing is settled at the shipping door.
videos.clip.IjZBfRGDyys.a2: Packing is specified per destination and confirmed in the quotation; tell us the destination and transit conditions so we set the packing list.
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.s1: Hot press stage: heat and pressure applied to the joint
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.s2: Joint cured so it holds under load instead of letting go
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.s3: The step that decides whether a belt lasts or fails
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.s4: Done on the same site as cutting and slitting
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.q1: Why did my last belt open at the joint?
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.a1: Joint failure usually traces to cure time or press settings. State the machine, load and speed and we confirm the construction against your application.
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.q2: What joint types do you supply?
videos.clip.OQsS-o8DPfU.a2: Joint type and edge treatment are specified per reference in the quotation.
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.s1: Private-label run: slit to width, grade and backing check, label, export pack
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.s2: Your label applied and verified before the carton is sealed
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.s3: Slitting jumbo rolls to custom widths
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.s4: OEM programme from enquiry to dispatch
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.q1: What artwork do you need for private label?
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.a1: Print-ready artwork with the brand, label sizes and any required marks; artwork requirements are confirmed in the feasibility review.
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.q2: Can I order a trial run first?
videos.clip.BZyB_1HKcZw.a2: Samples of standard references are available on request; OEM artwork approvals follow the confirmed specification.
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.s1: Field footage: heavy steel plate with a flap disc on an angle grinder
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.s2: Weld and mill scale taken down along the plate edge
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.s3: Shows working angle, pressure and disc loading on mill scale
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.s4: Useful reference for specifying grit on real conditions
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.q1: Why does my disc glaze on mill scale?
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.a1: Mill scale loads the abrasive quickly. Choose a coarser grit, keep the disc flat to the work and dress the surface as it loads.
videos.clip.QC5dm0_jJnY.a2: Coarse grit removes stock and scale efficiently; move to a finer grit for blending the edge afterwards.
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.s1: Bulk cloth orders: slitting jumbo rolls to measured widths
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.s2: Grade-by-grade warehouse stock and export packing
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.s3: Multiple specifications held in one supply chain
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.s4: Width tolerance and edge condition inherited from the converting site
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.q1: What width tolerance should I expect?
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.a1: Tolerance is stated in the quotation against the slit width; tell us the machine and application so the tolerance suits it.
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.q2: Can you hold stock for a rolling order?
videos.clip.kyI_1bAajAE.a2: Grade-by-grade stock is held for standard specifications; rolling orders are confirmed against a production schedule.
videos.clip.x0tj59ovgBw.s2: Built for weld finishing and surface preparation in metal fabrication
videos.clip.x0tj59ovgBw.s3: Grit, backing, diameter and arbor hole confirmed together
videos.clip.x0tj59ovgBw.s4: Supply for distributors, importers, workshops and fabrication shops
videos.clip.x0tj59ovgBw.q1: What is the most common enquiry fault?
videos.clip.x0tj59ovgBw.a1: A disc that fits nothing — diameter or arbor hole mismatched to the tool. Confirm all four together.
videos.clip.x0tj59ovgBw.a2: Yes. Flap discs are supplied in bulk for distributors and workshops; quantity, grit mix and packing are set in the quotation.
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.s1: 自研百叶片配合全自动产线，源头工厂直供
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.s2: 金属打磨、焊缝处理与工件表面预处理
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.s3: 现货秒发，支持大批量拿货
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.s4: OEM 贴牌定制与来图来样
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.q1: 百叶轮厚度与粒度可以定制吗？
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.a1: 可以。告知粒度、片数、背板与轴径要求，我们按确认规格报价并安排生产。
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.q2: 大批量供货的交期如何确认？
videos.clip.XfIphLNhZuk.a2: 现货规格快速发货；定制规格按报价中确认的生产排期执行。
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.s1: 焊缝打磨、木材去毛刺实拍
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.s2: 接背胶、砂布裁切叠层、热压固化全流程
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.s3: 成品耐磨不掉片，可用寿命可见
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.s4: 源头工厂支持定制样品与来图来样
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.q1: 百叶轮掉片是什么原因？
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.a1: 多与叠层压合和热压固化有关。片中热压段就是寿命来源，我们按确认工艺参数生产。
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.q2: 可以寄样确认后再批量吗？
videos.clip.ePTtos61dbE.a2: 可以。先寄样品确认粒度与背板，再按确认规格批量生产。
